content:
Rapid Growth in the Enterprise AI Market

The year 2025 was a period in which the integration of AI technologies into enterprise business processes accelerated. The enterprise AI market rose from $1.7 billion in 2023 to $37 billion, making up 6% of the SaaS market. This increase clearly shows companies’ demand for Generative AI and automation solutions.

Autonomous Agents and Hyperautomation

While the vast majority of companies began using AI in at least one business function, autonomous AI agents were positioned as the new phase of the digital workforce. Although these agents, which have the ability to make independent decisions, are still concentrated in pilot stages rather than full-scale production, they created concrete use cases in areas such as sales and legal technologies. Experts emphasize that processes should be designed not only for automation, but from the start in an AI-compatible way.

In back-end operations, hyperautomation, the combination of AI and robotic process automation (RPA), stood out. Automating repetitive tasks increased speed in data processing processes while providing savings in operational costs. In the physical world, the use of AI-supported robotic systems became widespread in warehouse management and production lines.

Infrastructure Transformation: Hybrid Cloud and Edge Computing

The increase in AI workloads changed cloud costs and processing requirements. Companies turned to hybrid models including combinations of cloud, on-premise servers, and edge computing for cost optimization and low latency. Especially in sectors requiring real-time decisions, such as finance and manufacturing, processing data at its source became a critical need.

2026 Expectations

In 2026, deeper human-machine collaboration and an increase in AI-supported cybersecurity measures are expected. The topics expected to stand out in the technology world in the coming period are as follows:

  • The transition of autonomous systems from pilot projects to production environments is expected to accelerate.
  • Quantum computing is expected to approach the threshold where it will surpass classical systems in certain problems.
  • In cybersecurity, zero trust architectures are expected to be strengthened with AI.
  • Sustainability data is expected to be monitored as closely as financial indicators.
